items.title: After signing a 4/64M dollar deal with the Milwaukee Bucks. Gary Trent Jr has amassed a total of 13 minute, 6 points, and 7 DNP - Coaches Decision’s in 9 games.
items.author: SwiftieForLife
items.body_excerpt: The Bucks can’t even be bothered to pretend he was worth the money. It’s honestly stunning to just seem to embrace they circumvented the cap and can’t even defend it. I can’t remember anyone ever signing such a large deal and the team not playing them at all.
